profile.summary: PhD researcher in architectural acoustics with professional experience in architectural practice and a strong foundation in acoustics developed through master’s-level research. Experienced in acoustic simulation and auralization using ODEON, as well as on-site acoustic measurements including SPL, RT, and STC using Larson Davis 831 equipment. Skilled in data-driven analysis, EEG-based perceptual research, and Python, supported by an architectural background that enables an integrated approach to acoustic design and analysis.

acoustics.intro: My acoustics work combines field measurements, room-acoustic simulation, soundscape research, and studies of human responses to sound.

activities.title: Acoustic measurement
activities.description: Supported SPL, reverberation-time (RT), and sound transmission class (STC) measurements in research and laboratory settings.

activities.title: Acoustic simulation
activities.description: Developed and investigated a virtual acoustic model of the Sandiaoling Ecological Tunnel using ODEON to study reverberation behaviour.

activities.title: Soundscape field research
activities.description: Participated in in-situ soundscape measurements and documentation at recreational and urban environments in northern Taiwan.

activities.title: EEG and human perception
activities.description: Contributed to EEG-based perceptual-response studies, including device operation, Python-based data processing, and interpretation.

designProjects.title: Roller Sport Training Center
designProjects.description: A dynamic training complex in Yangon integrating a main building, skate park, skate rink, and outdoor skating area. The concept transforms roller-sport movements and equipment into architectural forms.

designProjects.title: Aureo Hotel
designProjects.description: A hotel project in Yangon inspired by the idea of gold. Golden accents, grey tones, and warm neutral materials carry the concept across the building and guest-room interiors.

designProjects.title: Laydaunt Kan Home Extension
designProjects.description: Surveyed and documented the existing building, recreated architectural drawings from original blueprints, and supported the extension design development and detailing.
